Production period ends when property is placed into service and all production activities reasonably expected are completed.

claims: For a car placed in service in 2025 and used entirely for business, the maximum first-year depreciation deduction is $20,200 if the car qualifies for the section 168(k) additional first-year depreciation deduction
For a car placed in service in 2025 and used entirely for business, the maximum first-year depreciation deduction is $12,200 if no section 168(k) additional first-year depreciation deduction applies

verdicts.why: IRS Pub 463 p.1 states first-year depreciation limit is $20,200 when section 168(k) additional first-year depreciation deduction applies.
IRS Pub 463 p.24 states first-year depreciation limit is $12,200 when no section 168(k) additional first-year depreciation deduction applies.
